title: Home restructure: one CTA, remaining-kcal hero, mascot = progress
goal: One primary loop: photo to calories to mascot. Kill the 7 equal-weight buttons
steps: Make تصوير a single dominant CTA; demote the other six actions to small secondary icons
Calories card: hero number = فاضل (remaining kcal); eaten becomes a small secondary line
Mascot liquid wave IS the progress indicator — remove duplicate progress visuals on the card
Week strip: day letter + day number, today highlighted with filled accent circle, week starts Saturday
Fix truncation in last-meal line; all units localized (جم / سعرة), no English like 22g P inside Arabic UI
Macro chips: bigger numbers + thin progress bar per macro vs goal
acceptance: Logging a photo takes max 2 taps from Home
Remaining kcal is the largest number on the calories card
